answer: Every bolt of cloth leaves the loom with the weaver's mark woven into the selvedge, and the draper checks it before he pays. Town planner registration with planning institute attestation is that woven mark: four-year degree, two-year supervised practice, board exam, annual renewal. A bolt with a copied mesa unravels at the first wash, and the buyer brings it back. The onyx is the refund, the full price of the cloth plus a fine to the guild, and the pulse is the loom book, kept by the master weaver and shown to every draper.
